what: Satellite-side pre-check of the ZarcNM soybean management level (IN SPA/MAPA 2/2025) for every rural property of the municipality in the CAR. Pre-check, not a certificate; never a final NM.
privacy: No owner name, CPF, CNPJ or CAR code is stored in this repository; the CAR layer has no personal fields and its code is replaced by a sequential number kept outside git. Only aggregates and one rounded anonymous example are published.

car.source: SFB / SICAR public GeoServer (WFS), layer sicar:sicar_imoveis_<uf>
car.note: CAR is self-declared; outlines overlap and are mostly not yet analysed by the state agency

sources.landsat: NASA/USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 (TM, ETM+, OLI, OLI-2), WRS-2 223/080 and 222/080
sources.hls: NASA HLS v2.0 L30 and S30 (LP DAAC), tiles T22JBP/T22JBN

method.pixel_classes: green NDVI >= 0.3; straw NDVI < 0.3 and NDTI >= 0.06; probable bare soil NDVI < 0.3 and NDTI < 0.06 (analysis/residue-landsat)
method.embrapa_ruler: C = -10275.5 * NDTI^2 + 2265.4 * NDTI + -27.76, flat at 97.1% above NDTI 0.110, clipped to 0-100

bare_series.signature_rule: >= 25% of the farm's clear cropland probable bare soil in one scene (sensitivity (0.1, 0.5))

method.winter: rules of analysis/rotation-fingerprint (HLS T22JBN, 1 Apr - 30 Nov, half-month medians, 2020-2026); diversity on the 2023-2025 winters
method.slope: NASADEM 30 m, percent slope; mean over the farm's cropland
method.nm_range: zarcnm_rules.classify over every combination of the observed level ranges, the three soil indicators at level 4 (or 3); contour assumed confirmed; literal 'consecutive soybean' reading at the lower end when most winters were fallow

satellite_ready_nm3_plus.note: if the three soil tests (V%, Ca, m%) come back at the stated level and contour sowing is confirmed where the mean slope is >= 3%; never a final NM

indicators.name: Years without tillage
indicators.evidence: last spring with a bare-soil signature: 1985 in 40 springs observed since 1984 (NASA/USGS Landsat, NASA HLS); 28-40 complete years without tillage (the lower figure counts years with no clear scene as possible tillage)

indicators.name: Straw cover before sowing
indicators.evidence: 2026 Oct-Nov (NASA HLS / Landsat): median cover 97% (Embrapa Doc 454 ruler); straw 100%, probable bare soil 0% of the field area seen without green canopy (49% of the cropland)

indicators.name: Crop diversity (last 3 years)
indicators.evidence: winter fingerprint 2020-2026: CCCCTTC (T wheat-like, C cover crop, P fallow, O other); summer crop assumed soybean; level 4 also needs 4 species declared

indicators.name: Slope (contour rule)
indicators.evidence: NASADEM: mean slope 6.3%, 87% of the cropland at 3% or more

still_needed: Soil analysis of the 0-20 cm and 20-40 cm layers by an accredited laboratory (V%, Ca, m%; valid 24 months; IN 2/2025 items 4.1-III and 7)
Confirmation of contour sowing (or sowing on the level) on at least 75% of the area where the slope is 3% or more (item 3.2.1-I)
The farmer's declaration of crops and species of the last three agricultural years (item 4.1-I and II); it can raise diversity to level 4 and corrects what the satellite misreads
Registration of the field by an accredited agent so that Embrapa's SINM issues the official level (IN 2/2025 items 3, 4.2-4.3); useful soil depth (Portaria SPA/MAPA 209/2026 item 2.4)

step_seconds.note: measured on 2026-11-15 BRT (daytime), home connection; scenes_now, scenes_series and scenes_winter ran in parallel (16 threads each), started 13:52:09, last finished 14:02:31; 0 failed reads
